en: The postcard image depicts an old industrial glass factory complex with large brick buildings, arched windows, and two tall chimneys. The landscape is flat with visible fields in the background, suggesting a semi-rural or suburban setting. The title text at the top reads 'Neusörnewitz.' and 'Glasfabrik A.-G. Neusörnewitz.' indicating the site is the Neusörnewitz Glass Factory. At the bottom, there is a publisher's imprint: 'Brück & Sohn, Meissen.'
